name: synthetic trading system (qdperf.synth_db)
description: 三进程共用一个 SQLite（WAL）：http = 面板 / API，engine = 交易引擎 tick，notifier = 通知。参数样例对任意 --scale 的合成库都有效。

http.description: HTTP 进程：面板轮询与 API

engine.description: 交易引擎：每 tick 读挂单、写订单 / 成交 / bot 心跳（一个事务）

notifier.description: 通知进程：取待发告警、标记已发、写事件、清理旧事件

statements.sql: SELECT id, symbol, side, price, qty, status, created_at FROM orders WHERE user_id = ? AND status = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT id, symbol, side, price, qty, fee, ts FROM trades WHERE user_id = ? AND ts >= ? ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT id, name, strategy, symbol, status FROM bots WHERE user_id = ?
SELECT id, email, tier FROM users WHERE id = ?
SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = ?
SELECT symbol, count(*), sum(price * qty) FROM trades WHERE ts >= ? GROUP BY symbol
SELECT id, kind, level, ts, payload FROM events WHERE user_id = ? ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE email LIKE ?
SELECT o.id, o.price, b.name FROM orders o JOIN bots b ON b.id = o.bot_id WHERE o.user_id = ? AND o.created_at >= ?
INSERT INTO events(user_id, bot_id, kind, level, notified, ts, payload) VALUES (?, ?, 'login', 'info', 1, ?, ?)
UPDATE bots SET status = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?
SELECT id, side, price, qty, filled FROM orders WHERE bot_id = ? AND status = 'open'
SELECT id, user_id, symbol, config FROM bots WHERE status = 'running' AND updated_at < ?
SELECT price FROM trades WHERE symbol = ? ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
INSERT INTO orders(bot_id, user_id, symbol, side, type, price, qty, filled, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'limit', ?, ?, 0, 'open', ?, ?)
INSERT INTO trades(order_id, bot_id, user_id, symbol, side, price, qty, fee, ts) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
UPDATE orders SET status = ?, filled = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?
UPDATE bots SET updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?
SELECT id, user_id, kind, payload FROM events WHERE level = 'alert' AND notified = 0 ORDER BY ts LIMIT 100
UPDATE events SET notified = 1 WHERE id = ?
INSERT INTO events(user_id, bot_id, kind, level, notified, ts, payload) VALUES (?, ?, 'alert', 'alert', 0, ?, ?)
SELECT email FROM users WHERE id = ?
DELETE FROM events WHERE ts < ?
